hebrewText: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה בּ֡/וֹ אֶת גְּדוּדֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּים֩ וְ/אֶת גְּדוּדֵ֨י אֲרָ֜ם וְ/אֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְ/אֵת֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֥/ם בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה לְ/הַֽאֲבִיד֑/וֹ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥י/ו הַ/נְּבִיאִֽים

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.

As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

tokens.bdb: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
